title: compile.ts: shape with filters missing PlaceFlagMove in posChanged branch
description:
In compile.ts, the posChanged branch for shape/drawing-object types calls encodePlaceObject3WithFilters without move=true (lines ~2175-2185). This means when a shape with enabled filters changes position/transform across frames, the SWF emits PlaceObject3 with HasCharacter set and HasMove NOT set — Ruffle re-places the character at the depth instead of moving the existing one.

Fix: pass true as the 9th argument (move) to encodePlaceObject3WithFilters at the shape posChanged path:
  encodePlaceObject3WithFilters(charId, depth, x, y, displayObj.filters!, objTransform, undefined, undefined, true)

Additionally, the instance posChanged branch (line ~2301) only handles hasBlend via PO3. An instance with filters only (no blend mode) falls through to the PO2 path, which emits PlaceObject2 without filter data — causing the filter to be silently dropped on subsequent frames. Fix: add a parallel hasEnabledFilters check in the instance posChanged branch that calls encodePlaceObject3WithFilters with move=true.
